versions.content: After initialization of the Service Discovery module by calling of the API Sd_Init() , all configured Eventgroups shall have the state “ SD_CONSUMED_EVENTGROUP_ RELEASED ”, unless a Consumed Eventgroup has “ SdConsumedEventGroupAutoRequired ” set to true , then the state shall be set to “ SD_CONSUMED_EVENTGROUP_REQUESTED ” as soon as the associated Client Service Instance is requested .
